info.name: KIDE API — by role (production)
info.description:
Grouped by caller role: Public, Admin, SM, ASM, BDE/Employee, plus security negative tests.

Run the login requests in 00 Public first; they store adminToken / smToken / asmToken / bdeToken in collection variables.

Base URL defaults to production. Change the baseUrl variable to http://localhost:3000 for local testing.
